segments.text: We are not Individuals but States: Combinations of Individuals

quotations.context: Seven Angels converse; not a constitutional pronouncement.

segments.text: But the Divine Humanity & Mercy gave us a Human Form as multitudes
Because we were combind in Freedom & holy Brotherhood Vox Populi
While those combind by Satans Tyranny first in the blood of War
And Sacrifice &, next, in Chains of imprisonment: are Shapeless Rocks
Retaining only Satans Mathematic Holiness, Length: Bredth & Highth

quotations.context: Freedom and coercive aggregation contrasted. ASU text retains as multitudes, printed marginally in copy D.

segments.text: Distinguish therefore States from Individuals in those States.
States Change: but Individual Identities never change nor cease:
You cannot go to Eternal Death in that which can never Die.

quotations.context: Individual identities are not expendable instances of collective forms.

segments.text: The Imagination is not a State: it is the Human Existence itself
Affection or Love becomes a State, when divided from Imagination
The Memory is a State always, & the Reason is a State
Created to be Annihilated & a new Ratio Created
Whatever can be Created can be Annihilated Forms cannot
The Oak is cut down by the Ax, the Lamb falls by the Knife
But their Forms Eternal Exist, For-ever. Amen Halle[l]ujah

quotations.context: Imagination is not a state; created ratios differ from eternal forms.

segments.text: The Spiritual States of
the Soul are all Eternal
Distinguish between the
Man, & his present State

quotations.context: Right epigraph reconstructed in its own reading order; small-type location labels and left/central column layout omitted. No invented verse numbering.

segments.text: Albion hath enterd the State Satan! Be permanent O State!
And be thou for ever accursed! that Albion may arise again:
And be thou created into a State! I go forth to Create
States: to deliver Individuals evermore! Amen.

quotations.context: Permanence of an accursed state is compatible with deliverance of persons.

segments.text: In Great Eternity, every particular Form gives forth or Emanates
Its own peculiar Light, & the Form is the Divine Vision
And the Light is his Garment This is Jerusalem in every Man
A Tent & Tabernacle of Mutual Forgiveness Male & Female Clothings.
And Jerusalem is called Liberty among the Children of Albion

quotations.context: Emanation occurs in Great Eternity; it cannot simply mean temporal birth.

segments.text: As the Pilgrim passes while the Country permanent remains
So Men pass on: but States remain permanent for ever

quotations.context: Pilgrimage is a simile, not a jurisdictional map.

segments.text: I elected Albion for my glory; I gave to him the Nations,
Of the whole Earth. he was the Angel of my Presence: and all
The Sons of God were Albions Sons: and Jerusalem was my joy.

quotations.context: Election and gift of nations complicate a straightforward pluralist reconstruction.

segments.text: What do I see? The Briton Saxon Roman Norman amalgamating
In my Furnaces into One Nation the English: & taking refuge
In the Loins of Albion. The Canaanite united with the fugitive
Hebrew, whom she divided into Twelve, & sold into Egypt
Then scatterd the Egyptian & Hebrew to the four Winds!
This sinful Nation Created in our Furnaces & Looms is Albion
So Los spoke. Enitharmon answerd in great terror in Lambeths Vale

quotations.context: Los names English amalgamation and calls the nation sinful; generation does not imply approval.

segments.text: When in Eternity Man converses with Man they enter
Into each others Bosom (which are Universes of delight)
In mutual interchange. and first their Emanations meet
How then can I ever again be united as Man with Man
While thou my Emanation refusest my Fibres of dominion.

quotations.context: Noncontiguous excerpts; omitted lines 6-11 are explicitly indicated in attribution, not silently continuous.

quotations.locator: Letter to Thomas Butts, 22 November 1802, verse 83-88, E722

segments.text: Now I a fourfold vision see
And a fourfold vision is given to me
Tis fourfold in my supreme delight
And three fold in soft Beulahs night
And twofold Always. May God us keep
From Single vision & Newtons sleep

quotations.context: Visionary sequence, not a ranked franchise or organ count.

quotations.locator: The Marriage of Heaven and Hell, plate 7, E36

segments.text: Eternity is in love with the productions of time.

quotations.context: One of the Proverbs of Hell in a dialogic work; not universal approval of every product.
Mutual exchange in To the Jews; read with the religious framing of the plate.

segments.text: In my Exchanges every Land
Shall walk, & mine in every Land,
Mutual shall build Jerusalem:
Both heart in heart & hand in hand.

quotations.context: Final human forms, return, and emanations; compare gender and agency with the final design.

segments.text: All Human Forms identified even Tree Metal Earth & Stone. all
Human Forms identified, living going forth & returning wearied
Into the Planetary lives of Years Months Days & Hours reposing
And then Awaking into his Bosom in the Life of Immortality.
And I heard the Name of their Emanations they are named Jerusalem
Labour well the Minute Particulars, attend to the Little-ones:
And those who are in misery cannot remain so long
If we do but our duty: labour well the teeming Earth.

quotations.context: The Seven Eyes address labor, misery and prevention before the plowing scene.

segments.text: He who would do good to another, must do it in Minute Particulars
General Good is the plea of the scoundrel hypocrite flatterer:
For Art & Science cannot exist but in minutely organized Particulars
And not in generalizing Demonstrations of the Rational Power.

quotations.context: The plowing and the Seven Eyes connect works and minutely organized particulars with the critique of general good.

segments.text: You accumulate Particulars, & murder by analyzing, that you
May take the aggregate; & you call the aggregate Moral Law:
And you call that Swelld & bloated Form; a Minute Particular.
But General Forms have their vitality in Particulars: & every
Particular is a Man; a Divine Member of the Divine Jesus.
So Los cried at his Anvil in the horrible darkness weeping!

quotations.context: Los addresses the Spectre at his anvil; the speech is followed by the Spectre's stupendous works and Los's coercion.

segments.text: The stones are pity, and the bricks, well wrought affections:
Enameld with love & kindness, & the tiles engraven gold
Labour of merciful hands: the beams & rafters are forgiveness:
The mortar & cement of the work, tears of honesty: the nails,
And the screws & iron braces, are well wrought blandishments,
And well contrived words, firm fixing, never forgotten,
Always comforting the remembrance: the floors, humility,

quotations.context: Excerpt within the Golgonooza building description; Jerusalem remains outside the gate at12:43–44.

segments.text: Saying, Doth Jehovah Forgive a Debt only on condition that it shall
Be Payed? Doth he Forgive Pollution only on conditions of Purity
That Debt is not Forgiven! That Pollution is not Forgiven
Such is the Forgiveness of the Gods, the Moral Virtues of the
Heathen, whose tender Mercies are Cruelty. But Jehovahs Salvation
Is without Money & without Price, in the Continual Forgiveness of Sins
In the Perpetual Mutual Sacrifice in Great Eternity! for behold!

quotations.context: Joseph reports a dream-voice on conditional forgiveness following Mary's challenge to rejection; mutual sacrifice remains within the excerpt.

segments.text: 8. Laws of peace, of love, of unity:
Of pity, compassion, forgiveness.
Let each chuse one habitation:
His ancient infinite mansion:
One command, one joy one desire,
One curse, one weight, one measure
One King, one God, one Law.

quotations.context: Urizen concludes laws of peace, love, unity, pity, compassion and forgiveness with one command, joy, desire, measure, king, god and law; Eternals respond with rage.

segments.text: And form'd laws of prudence, and call'd them
The eternal laws of God

quotations.context: The children mourn and build tombs before naming their prudential laws eternal divine laws; neighboring cities become mutually imperceptible.

segments.text: The Sons of Los clothe them & feed, & provide houses & gardens

quotations.context: Los’s sons provide clothing, food, houses and gardens for spectres; the surrounding work includes feuds, weapons and creation/destruction.

segments.text: Inclosing all the Children of Los time after time.
Their Giant forms condensing into Nations & Peoples & Tongues

quotations.context: Enclosure and bodily labor precede the condensation into nations, peoples and tongues; national generation includes pain, gender and continual building/decay.

segments.text: Yet the intoxicating delight that they take in their work
Obliterates every other evil; none pities their tears
Yet they regard not pity & they expect no one to pity
For they labour for life & love, regardless of any one
But the poor Spectres that they work for, always incessantly

quotations.context: Read 59:26–55 on hunger, delight, labor and repair beside provision at 73:44–54.

segments.text: The Spectre is the Reasoning Power in Man; & when separated
From Imagination, and closing itself as in steel, in a Ratio
Of the Things of Memory. It thence frames Laws & Moralities
To destroy Imagination! the Divine Body, by Martyrdoms & Wars

quotations.context: The Spectre is reason separated from imagination and self-enclosed in remembered ratios. Read entire J74, including Divine Law, Los driving people away, and cruel division of sixteen into twelve; not a general rejection of reason, measurement or law.

segments.text: Learn therefore O Sisters to distinguish the Eternal Human
That walks about among the stones of fire in bliss & woe
Alternate! from those States or Worlds in which the Spirit travels:
This is the only means to Forgiveness of Enemies[.]

quotations.context: Erin addresses the Daughters of Beulah. Person/state distinction enables forgiveness of enemies amid punitive heavens and Luvah/Satan differentiation. J50 proceeds to remembrance of sin; no institutional duty to forget evidence or require a victim to forgive follows.

quotations.locator: Letter to Thomas Butts, 22 November 1802, verse 25–30, E721

segments.text: What to others a trifle appears
Fills me full of smiles or tears
For double the vision my Eyes do see
And a double vision is always with me
With my inward Eye 'tis an old Man grey
With my outward a Thistle across my way

quotations.context: Double vision of a thistle/old man in a commissioned-work and family context. The speaker destroys the thistle at41–42, and the old man welters at53–54. The fourfold declaration at83–88 is already Q12 and is not proposed again.

segments.text: And they conversed together in Visionary forms dramatic which bright
Redounded from their Tongues in thunderous majesty, in Visions
In new Expanses, creating exemplars of Memory and of Intellect
Creating Space, Creating Time according to the wonders Divine
Of Human Imagination, throughout all the Three Regions immense

quotations.context: Selected five-line excerpt; sentence continues into98:33. Conversation creates exemplars, space and time. Entire plate also contains annihilation, irresistible movement, One Man, fitness/order and the covenant; creative reciprocity is not demonstrated equal political standing.

segments.text: I must Create a System, or be enslav'd by another Mans
I will not Reason & Compare: my business is to Create

quotations.context: Los resists enslavement while compelling his Spectre; creation and coercion share the scene.

segments.text: Striving with Systems to deliver Individuals from those Systems;

quotations.context: Deliverance from systems occurs within continued labor and threatened persons.

segments.text: Fixing their Systems, permanent: by mathematic power
Giving a body to Falshood that it may be cast off for ever.
With Demonstrative Science piercing Apollyon with his own bow!

quotations.context: Making falsehood definite can expose it to rejection; mathematical fixation has a dramatic use.

segments.text: Every word and every letter is studied and put into its fit
place: the terrific numbers are reserved for the terrific
parts--the mild & gentle, for the mild & gentle parts, and the
prosaic, for inferior parts: all are necessary to each other.

quotations.context: Opening and methodological discussion: differentiated poetic form is organized at the level of letters and cadences.

segments.text: Poetry Fetter'd, Fetters the Human Race! Nations are Destroy'd,
or Flourish, in proportion as Their Poetry Painting and Music,
are Destroy'd or Flourish! The Primeval State of Man, was Wisdom,
Art, and Science.

quotations.context: Opening: national life depends on the condition of artistic practices.

segments.text: Which vary according as the Organs of Perception vary & they walked
To & fro in Eternity as One Man reflecting each in each & clearly seen
And seeing: according to fitness & order. And I heard Jehovah speak

quotations.context: Conclusion and compositional model: reciprocal seeing within the poem’s One Man.

segments.text: Where are the Kingdoms of the World & all their glory that grew on Desolation
The Fruit of Albions Poverty Tree when the Triple Headed Gog-Magog Giant
Of Albion Taxed the Nations into Desolation & then gave the Spectrous Oath
Such is the Cry from all the Earth from the Living Creatures of the Earth
And from the great City of Golgonooza in the Shadowy Generation
And from the Thirty-two Nations of the Earth among the Living Creatures

quotations.context: Fiscal/resource-conflict case: question burdens and extraction, with nations still present at the ending.
